title: VR Virtual Classroom
description: Remote VR classroom with real-time interaction and teacher streaming.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A VR Virtual Classroom for both students and teachers. Students simply put a phone into a VR Viewer (Google Cardboard) and open our app. They are seated at a desk in a classroom with their classmates around them, whose positions and rotations are updated in real-time. The teacher is at the front of the class, live-streaming their lesson through our teacher app on a blackboard. Students can raise their hands, stand up, and enjoy a realistic classroom experience.

sections.title: Technical Implementation
content: Unity - Virtual Classroom App and Design

sections.title: Purpose
sections.content: The Virtual Classroom allows students to enjoy a real classroom environment from the safety of their own homes, which was especially relevant during the COVID-19 pandemic.

sections.title: Achievement
sections.content: This project won Second Place at HackMIT 2020.
